scope: Followup of soğur to doğur corruption with offsets and sentence contexts
findings: Each of seven affected inputs changed at all three offsets.
Two semantic-context sentences ışığı soğuruyorsunuz and enerjiyi soğuruyorsunuz also changed to doğuruyorsunuz.
Controls doğuruyorsunuz, çağırıyorsunuz and çeviriyorsunuz preserved at all offsets.
Not all soğur inflections change: six tested other inflections preserved.
Root alternation code gates all vowel-initial suffixes when dropsVowel is set, not only suffixes that justify dropping.
limits: No claim sentence semantics influences decoder: production bigram model is absent.
Core simulated touches at center and ±0.2 width/height, not physical-device observations.
Did not run a modified production-pack decoder, so a flag fix alone has not been proven to repair ranking.
